text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGER - metering.counts.drift detected in us-east-1. Token-count delta > 12% vs baseline since 2026-03-15T03:05Z. Raising to #incidents. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-drift. Please ack and start triage.

oncall-sre: acked :eyes: I'm on pager. First step: validate source (ingest vs aggregator vs export).

Alice Chen: looking at kafka consumer lag and aggregator logs now. quick grep shows consumer group "metering-agg-us-east-1" restarted around 03:06Z.

Raj Patel: from billing-analytics: upstream counts spike at 03:07, coincides with a canary rollout of tokenizer v2 on generator-service. spike shape looks like duplicated messages (same request_id seen twice).

Morgan Lee: grabbing logs from generator-service canary pods. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T03:05:42Z generator-1 INFO request_id=xyz token_count=142 idempotency_key=
2026-03-15T03:05:43Z generator-1 WARN missing idempotency header, retrying
```
seems retries are missing idempotency header sometimes.

Diego Ramos: ran quick SQL sample on stage-aggregator: 
```sql
SELECT request_id, COUNT(*) as hits, MIN(received_at) as first_seen
FROM metering.events
WHERE region = 'us-east-1' AND received_at >= '2026-03-15T03:00:00Z'
GROUP BY request_id
HAVING hits > 1
LIMIT 10;
```
results: multiple request_ids with hits=2..3 -> clear dedupe gap.

BillingBot: :warning: overage-notify rule firing: 27 customers flagged for potential overage since 03:10Z. Emails queued.

Alice Chen: mitigation proposal: 1) pause overage emails, 2) pause live writes to billing-aggregator (switch to write-to-s3/backfill mode), 3) roll tokenizer canary back to v1, 4) deploy hotfix in aggregator to ensure dedupe by (request_id + source_hash).

oncall-sre: +1 to pause emails & switch writes. Can we do rollback quickly? if rollback normalizes counts we can avoid hotfix.

Raj Patel: I'm preparing a hotfix branch: fix will ignore events with null idempotency header and use request_id hash for dedupe. Pushing PR now.

Morgan Lee: doing a canary rollback to tokenizer v1 in us-east-1-canary: 
```bash
kubectl -n prod deploy rollout undo generator-service --to-revision=42 -l region=us-east-1,canary=true
```
monitoring cpu & token_count metrics.

Alice Chen: pausing overage emails: running `billing/alert-control pause overage-emails --scope=us-east-1 --reason="metering drift"`
BillingBot: overage-emails paused for us-east-1 (27 pending) :white_check_mark:

Diego Ramos: ran quick dry-run backfill (recompute) against s3 snapshot to estimate delta: found +1.18M tokens duplicated across 1200 customers in window 03:05-03:12. Estimate ~$320 in aggregate potential extra charges.

billing-ops: please prepare customer comms for top 10 impacted accounts and provision temporary credits. template draft below: 
"We identified a metering issue affecting usage reports between 03:05-03:12 UTC. We are rolling back the canary and pausing alerts. We will reconcile usage and apply credits where appropriate. Apologies for the noise. - Redwood Billing Ops"

Raj Patel: PR merged to hotfix branch, creating a canary deploy for the aggregator with dedupe patch applied to one pod. Command: `deploy ci/agg-hotfix --patch dedupe-v1 --replicas 1 --region us-east-1`

oncall-sre: canary runs for 5m - watching error rates and token_count ingestion.

IncidentBot: :information_source: Status update posted to status.redwood.ai - Incident classification: Sev3 (customer facing due to overage emails).

Morgan Lee: after rollback, canary generator-service instances show stabilized token_count streams. sample metric: token_rate back to baseline within ~90s.

Alice Chen: after dedupe hotfix canary, duplicates drop in aggregator sample. planning global rollout of hotfix + rollback of tokenizer across us-east in 15m.

billing-ops: preparing manual credits for affected customers. will send the template + account list to SOC for approval.

Diego Ramos: started reconciliation job to compute final deltas (recompute aggregation with dedupe enabled) — job id: recon-240123-1. Expect ETA ~45m.

BillingBot: overage emails remain paused globally while reconciliation runs.

oncall-sre: if reconciliation shows <5% customer impact we'll close as post-incident with credits applied. If >5% we keep Sev3 and escalate to product for billing policy review.

billing-ops: prepping outbound for top 10 now. cc @Alice Chen for reconciliation numbers.

IncidentBot: incident ledger: initiated at 2401239876, acknowledged by oncall-sre, mitigations: paused emails, rollback tokenizer canary, dedupe hotfix canary, reconciliation job started. Customer impact: transient overage flags (27 customers pending), estimated erroneous charge ~$320 aggregate.

Alice Chen: adding checklist to runbook with steps we took and commands used. will link postmortem when incident closed.

oncall-sre: thanks all. monitoring tilt still green in canary. keeping channel open for updates. :thumbsup:
